questions.q: Show me: name three ways to be active indoors.
questions.a: For example: star jumps, skipping, stretching, tidying.

questions.q: Why should screens go off before bed?
questions.a: Screens keep the brain awake and make it harder to sleep.

questions.q: Core: Fill in your own daily routine sheet with lessons, activity, meals, prayer times and bedtime (pupil PDF).
questions.a: A routine with at least 60 minutes of activity and 9 or more hours of sleep.

questions.q: Extend: Add three 2-minute stretch breaks between lessons to your routine.
Stretch: Explain how sleep helps your learning.
questions.a: The brain rests and stores what we learned; we concentrate better.

questions.q: About how much sleep do children your age need?
questions.a: B) 9 to 11 hours. Children aged 6 to 12 need about 9 to 12 hours.

questions.q: How much activity should children get each day? A) 10 minutes B) about 60 minutes C) none
Big question: how will you move enough on online school days?
questions.a: For example: stretch breaks and play outside after lessons.
